name: Technical Design Report for the ATLAS Inner Tracker Pixel Detector
notes: Date recorded at year precision from the report number (CERN-LHCC-2017-021); the INSPIRE literature listing (src:atlas-phase2-tdrs-inspire) does not give an exact month/day.

summary.plain: The plan to replace ATLAS's innermost tracking layers with an all-silicon pixel detector for the high-luminosity LHC.
summary.technical: ATLAS ITk Pixel TDR (CERN-LHCC-2017-021, ATLAS-TDR-030, 2017): design of the Phase-II Inner Tracker pixel system replacing the current pixel detector and SCT for HL-LHC running.
